title: nb: an exploration can be marked done on an interim-only or invalidated-only result
body:
Found in the spec-vs-code review of branch `worktree-agent-af4147e78b41b3bce` on 2026-11-09. Line numbers are that branch.

SPEC: an interim result "does not close anything"; an exploration becomes `done` once it has at least one result.

`cmd_status` (`bin/nb` line 1249) checks only that a `produces` link exists. Reproduced by two reviewers: `nb result <xpl> partial --interim` then `nb status <xpl> done` succeeds; so does an exploration whose only result is invalidated. The spec is silent on the invalidated case. No test covers either.
